responsibility: This header defines the `ampere1a_tunings` model for the Ampere-1A core variant in the AArch64 backend. It reuses the broader Ampere-1 vector-cost and prefetch data but changes the tuning bundle’s extra-cost source and fusible-operation mask to model Ampere-1A-specific instruction fusion behavior, so backend cost and scheduling heuristics can distinguish this variant from the baseline Ampere-1 tuning.
